blocks.text: INGLEWOOD, Calif. — Luka Doncic is sitting out of the Los Angeles Lakers’ game against the Los Angeles Clippers on Wednesday night because of back tightness. Doncic is the reigning NBA scoring champion and he leads the league again with 36.0 points per game this season after scoring 41 against Portland on Tuesday night. The Trail Blazers won 136-129, handing the Lakers (3-1) their first loss of the season.
